name: Purchase Quantity Quantiles
query:
STATE state FOR LEADING OBJECT TYPE 'Purchase Order' AS CASE
  WHEN object.po_quantity IS NULL OR QUANTILE(object.po_quantity, 0.5) IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
  WHEN object.po_quantity = QUANTILE(object.po_quantity, 0.1) AND object.po_quantity = QUANTILE(object.po_quantity, 0.9) THEN 'Typical Purchase'
  WHEN object.po_quantity <= QUANTILE(object.po_quantity, 0.1) THEN 'Small Purchase'
  WHEN object.po_quantity >= QUANTILE(object.po_quantity, 0.9) THEN 'Large Purchase'
  ELSE 'Typical Purchase'
END
